qs=set(q)

for s in w.sheetnames:
 ws=w[s]; groups={}
 for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2,values_only=True):
  groups.setdefault((r[2],r[3],r[5]>0),[]).append((r[4],r[5]))
 for (cy,cs,sgn),a in groups.items():
  genes=[x[0] for x in sorted(a,key=lambda x:-abs(x[1]))]
  inter=len(qs&set(genes))
  exact=sum(a==b for a,b in zip(q,genes))
  prefix=0
  for a,b in zip(q,genes):
   if a"'!=b: break
   prefix+=1
  hits.append((inter/max(1,len(qs|set(genes))),inter,exact,prefix,len(genes),s,cy,cs,sgn,genes[:10]))
for x in sorted(hits,reverse=True)[:30]: print(x)
